questions.text: How consistently do you eat at roughly similar times each day?
questions.helperText: Think about breakfast, lunch, and dinner — not perfection, just a general rhythm.

questions.text: How often do your meals include a recognizable mix of protein, carbs, and produce?
questions.helperText: A balanced plate does not need to be perfect — just intentional enough to feel structured.

questions.text: How often do you pause to notice how a meal affects your energy or comfort afterward?
questions.helperText: Observation is a skill — even brief check-ins count.

questions.text: How often do you have a rough plan for what you will eat in the next 24 hours?
questions.helperText: A plan can be as simple as knowing where your next meal is coming from.

questions.text: How ready do you feel to observe and log what you eat for a week without changing everything at once?
questions.helperText: Readiness is about starting with observation, not overhauling your whole routine.
